title: Vydyvo
profTagline: A living screensaver: a new picture from your words every few minutes, lit for your theme.
installDesc: Works offline, opens like an app
installIosHint: In Safari: tap Share, then Add to Home Screen.
installGenericHint: In the browser menu choose Install or Add to Home screen.
eNetwork: No connection. The show goes on from the collection
eRate: Too many requests. Pausing a few minutes
eBusy: Every GPU is taken. Pausing a few minutes
eTimeout: The picture took too long. Trying later
eSignIn: Sign in so new pictures can be painted
l_still_1: Silence is not the absence of sound but the presence of you
l_still_3: The wave never hurries to the shore, and always arrives
l_threshold_1: Every door is two sides of one step
l_threshold_2: An exit is always someone's entrance
l_threshold_3: A threshold never asks where you are going
l_memory_1: Memory keeps not the events but the light they happened in
l_memory_2: We return not to places but to who we were there
l_memory_3: What is forgotten does not vanish; it waits
l_depth_1: The deepest place is where you stop looking
l_depth_2: Everything has a bottom except attention
l_time_1: Time takes nothing away; it returns things to the earth
l_glow_1: Light does not fight the dark; it simply is
l_glow_2: A thread of light holds more than it seems
l_glow_3: What shines does not have to burn
